description: Mechanical cross-check of contraction_atoms.md: the general contractible-atom lemma, the triangle-pair lemma, the Type N/T local cubic-vertex dichotomy plus triangle uniqueness, the two-orbit functional-digraph classification, the five-lemma arithmetic toolkit (A, A', B, C, D, D3), and the bridge-arithmetic chord corollary.
scope_note: Tests only unconditional graph-theoretic mechanics on ordinary fixture graphs and explicit gadget constructions; does not and cannot test claims that presuppose a minimal Erdos-Gyarfas counterexample exists (contraction_atoms.md's 'clean-case' distinctness constraints in Parts V-VI, and the still-open non-clean/general cases). Kept separate from verifier/contraction_lift.py and its manifest, whose prior 35,357-cycle audit is untouched by this phase.
note_on_python_version: Same environment note as contraction_lift_manifest.json: requirements.txt/.python-version pin CPython 3.14.6, unavailable in this container (max available 3.13); this run used 3.13.12 with networkx==3.6.1 (matches requirements.txt's pin exactly).
fixtures: triangle_bearing_c4_free_fixture: cubic, C4-free, n=10, random_regular_graph(3,10,seed=12) -- rejection-sampled to give III.1's automatic-contractibility claim genuine triangle-plus-C4-free test coverage
15 random cubic-plus-extra-edge graphs, n in {8,10,12}, seeds 1000..1014

atom_contraction.note: same_vertex_lift_same_length is the mechanical fact (contracted-vertex neighbours coincide -> lift reproduces a same-length G-cycle), not itself an error; whether this is IMPOSSIBLE for a genuine minimal counterexample is the minimality argument proved in contraction_atoms.md Part I.4, not testable here.

detector_agreement: Every constructed lift/gadget cycle validated by two independent implementations (hand-rolled adjacency traversal verify_cycle, and independently constructed networkx traversal verify_cycle_nx, both imported from verifier/contraction_lift.py); 0 disagreements.
completed_range: All fixtures and gadget parameter ranges processed to completion (no partial/timeout runs); cycle enumeration in check_atom_contraction bounded at length 8 per graph (nx.simple_cycles length_bound=8), limiting how many mechanical instances are exercised, not the validity of any instance actually checked.
